meta.title: dsh-qgis-driver
meta.description:
Drive the QGIS running on this machine (dsh_qgis_driver plugin) from DeepSeek Harness: execute code on the QGIS main thread, submit background tasks and poll results. Instances are discovered through the plugin registry - no address or key to configure. The connection badge and the permission switch sit to the right of the composer; the badge can be hidden in Settings.

中文：从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机正在运行的 QGIS——在主线程执行代码、提交后台任务并轮询结果，无需配置地址或密钥。AI 辅助。
